properties.whose_line: OSM mappers: the area Suriname claims and France controls, between both parties' lines (Lawa and Marouini rivers)
properties.notes: Held by France (de facto administration); France's own commune of Maripasoula (IGN ADMIN EXPRESS) covers 3,490 of its 3,494.5 km². Natural Earth B14 is the same area. The register's 'about 5,000 square miles' does not match.
properties.operation: assembled from the OSM element's member ways (outer minus inner)
properties.crs: WGS84 longitude/latitude, as in the source (no reprojection)

source_features.name: Zone réclamée par le Suriname, contrôlée par la France
